items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Allen MacMillan knows what I'm talking about, 'cause he went all through Charleston and he went all through the Ohio territory. That is the man that coordinated this.

ctx.x: Were there any agents involved in this, any managers or anything, Jo?
Allen MacMillan. That's a very familiar name; we see it every day in New York City.
